scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n assets,apps,typecheck "node assets.mjs -w" "pnpm --parallel --filter './src/apps/*' run dev" "pnpm --recursive run typecheck --watch --preserveWatchOutput"
scripts.maintenance:development:on: pnpm --filter @allondeveen-portfolio/maintenance exec wrangler kv key put --binding RUNTIME_CONFIG maintenance-mode enabled
scripts.maintenance:development:off: pnpm --filter @allondeveen-portfolio/maintenance exec wrangler kv key put --binding RUNTIME_CONFIG maintenance-mode disabled
scripts.maintenance:staging:on: pnpm --filter @allondeveen-portfolio/maintenance exec wrangler kv key put --env staging --binding RUNTIME_CONFIG maintenance-mode enabled --remote
scripts.maintenance:staging:off: pnpm --filter @allondeveen-portfolio/maintenance exec wrangler kv key put --env staging --binding RUNTIME_CONFIG maintenance-mode disabled --remote
scripts.maintenance:production:on: pnpm --filter @allondeveen-portfolio/maintenance exec wrangler kv key put --env production --binding RUNTIME_CONFIG maintenance-mode enabled --remote
scripts.maintenance:production:off: pnpm --filter @allondeveen-portfolio/maintenance exec wrangler kv key put --env production --binding RUNTIME_CONFIG maintenance-mode disabled --remote
